htp_1_desc: All units move randomly. Your task is to choose the right cells for buildings.
htp_2_desc: Drag and drop a building from the bottom of the screen onto a cell of your color.
htp_3_desc: Each farm gives you a bunny, and each tower gives you a bull.
htp_4_desc: Bunnies capture neutral cells and collect wood, bringing it back to farms or the castle.
htp_5_desc: Bulls capture neutral and enemy cells and destroy enemy farms, towers and units.
proposition_tip: Watch an ad for a bonus!
ad_failed: Ad not available, try again later
